content.title: Micro Ecology to World | Scale Ladder and Title
content.summary: A tiny lit ecological clue becomes a recognizable thread through an intermediate built habitat to a much larger world context, while readable credits accompany movement and a fresh title holds after the scale reveal.

quick_start.input_format: Introduce one small light/life cue in an intimate composition and retain a recognizable visual motif as the scale grows. + Advance through at least one inhabited/constructed intermediate ecology before revealing its larger geographic or planetary container. + Place credits as readable overlays during travel and hold a distinct final original title on a visually calmer largest-scale frame.
quick_start.recommended_input: An original polar ecology documentary opening: a microscope view of a living microbe inside an ice-core bubble catches an amber glint; the camera then pulls back to the microscope table and the amber motif recurs on the physical ice-core sample tag and across an ice tunnel toward a field station, then resolves as one amber survey route on an overhead ice-field map; hold the new title 'LIVING ICE' in a steady final frame.
required_anchors: 片名在最终尺度稳定可读
usage_steps: Replace the example subject, setting, and surface details with an original concept.
Keep every required anchor and Creative DNA invariant causally visible.
Choose the MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 prompt and fill only the declared variable slots.
Check duration, event order, camera continuity, sound, and anti-copy constraints before generation.
applicable_scope: A tiny lit ecological clue becomes a recognizable thread through an intermediate built habitat to a much larger world context, while readable credits accompany movement and a fresh title holds after the scale reveal.
Original 4–15 second concepts that can preserve every required anchor.
MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 projects that need a reusable causal video structure.
not_suitable_for: Requests that copy the source identity, setting, props, dialogue, or shot order.
Concepts that cannot show all required anchors inside the target duration.
Long-form exposition or unrelated multi-location stories without a compact causal chain.

creative_dna.mechanism: A tiny lit ecological clue becomes a recognizable thread through an intermediate built habitat to a much larger world context, while readable credits accompany movement and a fresh title holds after the scale reveal.

invariants.rule: Introduce one small light/life cue in an intimate composition and retain a recognizable visual motif as the scale grows.
invariants.purpose: Gives the audience a thread across spaces.
invariants.ablation_failure: Unrelated pretty macro images will not connect to the later environment.

invariants.rule: Advance through at least one inhabited/constructed intermediate ecology before revealing its larger geographic or planetary container.
invariants.purpose: Creates a stepped scale ladder rather than an arbitrary cut to space.
invariants.ablation_failure: Skipping the middle habitat makes the cosmic image decorative rather than earned.

invariants.rule: Place credits as readable overlays during travel and hold a distinct final original title on a visually calmer largest-scale frame.
invariants.purpose: Makes the sequence function as a usable title opening.
invariants.ablation_failure: Moving text or premature title loses hierarchy and readability.

slots.name: micro_clue
slots.constraint: One distinctive life/light/material cue visible first at close scale.

slots.name: intermediate_habitat
slots.constraint: A coherent built or natural environment that spatially relates to the micro cue.

slots.name: large_container
slots.constraint: Larger world/context revealed after the habitat, not immediately.

slots.name: motif_handoff
slots.constraint: A traceable color/shape/light feature across all scales.

slots.name: credit_system
slots.constraint: Small readable credits that do not obscure the visual clue.

slots.name: title
slots.constraint: Original short legible title, held in a calmer final frame.

slots.name: sound
slots.constraint: Original audio arc; no attribution to unheard source soundtrack.

anti_copy_exclusions: No source title 'NINE MINUTES OF SUN', creator names, exact credit wording or source series premise.
No orbital seed archive, plant racks, circular planet porthole, space-station glide, exact droplet lens flare or source color/camera compositions in the primary output.
Do not invent a visible countdown or assert source sound events.

instantiations.concept: An original polar ecology documentary opening: a microscope view of a living microbe inside an ice-core bubble catches an amber glint; the camera then pulls back to the microscope table and the amber motif recurs on the physical ice-core sample tag and across an ice tunnel toward a field station, then resolves as one amber survey route on an overhead ice-field map; hold the new title 'LIVING ICE' in a steady final frame.
instantiations.prompt_seed: Polar ecology documentary; living microbe in ice bubble, amber physical sample tag, field tunnel and ice survey route, original title LIVING ICE.

instantiations.concept: An original underwater reef-monitoring opening: one fluorescent coral polyp emits a violet pulse; the pulse appears on a diver's sample gauge, then is tracked by an exterior sensor buoy before an overhead reef-current chart reveals the larger ecosystem; hold the new title 'REEF PULSE' in a calm final frame.
instantiations.prompt_seed: Underwater reef-monitoring opening; violet coral pulse, diver gauge, sensor buoy and reef-current chart, original title REEF PULSE.

failure_modes.failure: Macro clue vanishes and the later environment is unrelated.
failure_modes.repair: Repeat one measurable light/color/shape signal at intermediate and large scale.

failure_modes.failure: Credits become unreadable over busy moving imagery.
failure_modes.repair: Place short credits in protected negative space and reserve a stable end frame for title.

failure_modes.failure: Scale jumps directly from micro to planet.
failure_modes.repair: Include an intermediate habitat shot with directional camera travel.
